# YYG: עיצוב ובניית אתרים / Web design & development (Israel)

> YYG is the web design studio of Yehuda Gordon in Israel. It builds landing pages, small business websites with an admin panel, websites with sign-ups and mailing lists for institutions, nonprofits and classes, and online stores, plus logo design and branding. Payment: 10% to start, then clients see 3 complete design directions of their own site; 40% when they pick one; the remaining 50% at launch, after approval. Prices are final, and no VAT is added. Sites are fast, mobile-first, accessible and set up for Google. The first year of domain, hosting and business email is included.

## Prices (ILS, final, no VAT is added)
- Landing page: from ₪2,000 (3 design directions, 3 revision rounds, up to 4 business days)
- Basic landing page: ₪1,290 (1 design, 1 revision round, client provides the text, 1 month of support, 50% upfront and 50% at launch)
- Launch price: 10% off for the next 5 clients who agree to be shown as a case study with a written testimonial
- Website with admin panel: from ₪4,000 (up to 6 pages, up to 10 business days)
- Website with sign-ups & mailing list: from ₪6,000 (up to 15 business days)
- Online store: from ₪7,000 (up to 30 products uploaded, up to 20 business days)
- Basic logo ₪590; professional logo ₪1,500; basic brand identity ₪2,500
- Brand from 0 to 100% (branding + website + content + print + social + Google): from ₪5,900 / ₪7,900 / ₪9,900 / ₪10,900 (14 to 30 business days)
- All-in Care (domain, hosting, business email, security, backups and fixes) from year 2: ₪590 per year
- Maintenance (optional): updates and small changes, up to half an hour a month: ₪199 per month
- Extra page ₪350; extra design direction ₪400; extra revision round or an hour of work ₪150
- Every package except the basic landing page: start with 10%, 3 design directions, 3 revision rounds, 4 months of support after launch

## Contact
- Phone: 054-854-0700 (calls only), Sunday to Wednesday, 10:00–13:30 (Israel time)
- Website: https://yygweb.com (Hebrew), https://yygweb.com/en/ (English)
